why: RJ-F13, pending TK-7 (suiteui/timeline-keys) and the stage-matches-export fix (creative-core fix/flare-sampler, creative-apps fix/flare-stage-matches-export): platforms is [] so the harness skips it on both until the stage draws colour keys. Opens rect.flare (a new 30 fps scene, 30 frames), adds a rectangle, keys its fill blue at 0 and orange at 30 with colorKey.set, and exports Lottie. The trap: the Lottie animates but PNG frame 15 is flat blue (the stage gap). The assertions: the Lottie's fill `c` has two keys, blue then orange; the turn-on adds PNG frames 0, 15 and 30 and checks frame 15's fill pixel is within 3 levels of the blue-orange midpoint, then sets platforms to linux and macos.
